correctness.rationale: Pointwise Möbius inversion expresses the primitive indicator as a signed sum of period-subspace indicators. Character orthogonality yields equation (1). Only d=m*t with t|rad(n) survive; their annihilators are contained in H_m. On H_m the d=m term is an odd multiple of 2^m, every other term divisible by 2^(m+1), proving both full support and exact valuation. e_0+e_m is an explicit minimum-magnitude witness, while orthogonality and Fourier shift duality give exact stabilizer, rank and pseudoinverse norm. The independent direct-enumeration Walsh checker succeeded for all frequencies n=2..16 and translations n=2..8; enumeration alone is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete all-n Fourier-zero support and exact positive spectral gap answer a natural stability question for the group convolution operator generated by primitive binary words. The squarefree-radical integer m controls its nontrivial translation symmetry, Fourier support dimension and inverse norm, despite those quantities not being accessible from the familiar primitive necklace cardinality alone. This is a motivated natural complete classification, not a chosen finite instance or routine table increment; no general downstream theorem is asserted.
